Criteria: Routine issues or requests with standard procedures
Actions: - Address issue according to standard procedures. - Document issue and resolution.

Criteria: Issues not resolved at Level 1 or requiring higher authority
Actions: - Escalate to supervisor. - Review issue and take appropriate action. - Communicate progress to client.

Criteria: Critical issues affecting multiple clients or high- impact issues
Actions: - Escalate to manager. - Develop and implement action plan. - Provide regular updates to client and internal teams.
Contact Points: HR Team / Finance Team (based on issue type)

Criteria: Severe issues with significant impact or where other levels have failed
Actions: - Escalate to executive. - Oversee resolution strategy. - Ensure client satisfaction and final resolution. - Communicate final resolution and corrective actions.
